mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the age at the time of making the will."
The relevant age is the age at the time of making the will.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expression or intention by the legislature until assented to."
A bill is an expression or intention by the legislature until assented to.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful source of material for legislative draftsman."
Recommendation by the commission is a useful source of material for legislative draftsman.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the period of 24 hours starting at midnight, excluding fractions of a day."
Simply means the period of 24 hours starting at midnight, excluding fractions of a day.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a period of 12 months usually calculated from 1st January to 31st December."
A year is a period of 12 months usually calculated from 1st January to 31st December.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of expressing one's thought."
Language is a means of expressing one's thought.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a practical aspect of lawyer work."
Legal drafting is a practical aspect of lawyer work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person appointed and vested with the power by the testator to carry out the wishes of the testator in accordance with the will."
An executor is a person appointed and vested with the power by the testator to carry out the wishes of the testator in accordance with the will.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the foremost form of transfer of land in Nigeria."
Customary conveyancing is the foremost form of transfer of land in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument of disposition of property after one's life time."
Will is an instrument of disposition of property after one's life time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a customary way of transfering possession and right of use of land to the tenant on payment or even without payment of rent or tribute."
Customary tenancy is a customary way of transfering possession and right of use of land to the tenant on payment or even without payment of rent or tribute.
fib: ______ is an act of bringing to an end the operation of a will.
Revocation
Revocation is an act of bringing to an end the operation of a will.
______ is a supplementary will by which the testator alters, add to or revokes his or her earlier will.
codicil
A codicil is a supplementary will by which the testator alters, add to or revokes his or her earlier will.
______ is a form of communication in a permanent form.
Letter
Letter is a form of communication in a permanent form.
______ is the will law of the testator place of domicile.
relevant wills law
The relevant wills law is the will law of the testator place of domicile.
______ is the giver of the property while the grantee is the recipient of the property.
grantor
The grantor is the giver of the property while the grantee is the recipient of the property.
______ is the official language and the language of superior courts but under certain circumstance local languages are permitted.
English language
English language is the official language and the language of superior courts but under certain circumstance local languages are permitted.
______ is the submission of a committee at the conclusion of it work based on the terms of reference of the establishing instrument.
Report writing
Report writing is the submission of a committee at the conclusion of it work based on the terms of reference of the establishing instrument.
______ is a pervasive skill that all lawyers must possess because written communication is essential in the profession.
Writing
Writing is a pervasive skill that all lawyers must possess because written communication is essential in the profession.
______ is a form containing a list of matters on which instruction is to be taken.
Checklist
Checklist is a form containing a list of matters on which instruction is to be taken.
______ is an aspect of legal drafting.
Legislative drafting
Legislative drafting is an aspect of legal drafting.
______ is a gift to an alternative beneficiary where the first beneficiary is not capable of taking on the gift contemplated.
substitutional gift
A substitutional gift is a gift to an alternative beneficiary where the first beneficiary is not capable of taking on the gift contemplated.
According to the course material, how many classes of revocation are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two classes of revocation: (a) Voluntary revocation: This requires the intention of the testator. (b) Involuntary revocation: This does not require the intention of the testator but occurs by the operation of law.
